newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian shot after urinating on military wall.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian shot after urinating on military wall.

text.p: A Brazilian man who urinated against the wall of a military complex was shot and wounded by soldiers, a television station reported on Monday.
Francisco Xavier da Silva, 20, was hit in the back by a bullet near an air force base in Rio de Janeiro as he ran away from four guards on Friday, Globo television said.
"I went up to the wall and was having a pee when they came up to me and told me it was a military area," he said from a hospital bed, where he was recovering from intestinal surgery.
Da Silva said the guards shot him after he returned their insults and ran away. "Then they kicked me three times while I was on the ground, unable to do anything," he said.
An Air Force spokesman declined to comment on the report.
